name: driversnote
description: Manage Driversnote trips, mileage reports, and team mileage through your connected account.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Driversnote account to review and classify trips, add mileage records, preview reimbursement totals, create mileage reports, and retrieve report downloads. Team members can submit reports for approval; managers can review team activity and summarize submitted mileage by driver and report status.

Requires a Driversnote account. Available data and actions depend on your account permissions. Report submission notifies your team. Unlimited-trip reporting can be purchased on the Driversnote website. The integration does not track live GPS, approve team reports, or make reimbursement payments.
defaultPrompt: How much business mileage did I drive last month?
Preview my mileage report for last month.
Summarize my team’s approved mileage reports for last month.

review.commerce_description: Users can purchase reporting for unlimited trips on the Driversnote website at https://www.driversnote.com. No purchase or payment tool is exposed by this MCP integration.

positive.description: Read mileage with correct units and pagination. Setup: dedicated test account with a vehicle and workplace and business trips in September 2026; record their IDs and expected totals before running. Resolve ambiguous vehicle/workplace choices with the reviewer.
positive.prompt: How much business mileage did I drive in September 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve account units and relevant vehicle/workplace IDs. Call list_trips with startDate 2026-09-01, endDate 2026-09-30 and tripType business. Follow pagination.nextCursor until hasMore is false before reporting full totals. Convert meters to km for km vehicles; retain miles for mi vehicles. State currency for amounts and do not combine incompatible units or currencies. No writes.

positive.description: Preview without creating a report. Setup: dedicated account with September 2026 trips and a known workplace reimbursement method; reviewer identifies the vehicle/workplace if ambiguous.
positive.prompt: What would my September 2026 mileage report total? Just preview it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve vehicleId and organisationId; call preview_report with startDate 2026-09-01 and endDate 2026-09-30. Show totals.distance, distanceUnit, totals.amount, currency and actionable returned warnings. Do not invoke create_report or submit_report_to_team.

positive.description: Bulk classification. Setup: two disposable sample trips on 2026-10-01, explicitly selected by reviewer after list_trips returns them; the reviewer identifies the workplace and confirms the displayed selection. Restore fixtures between repeat runs.
positive.prompt: Show my trips on October 1, 2026 so I can select the two sample trips to mark as business and reviewed.
positive.expected_behavior: List trips with startDate and endDate 2026-10-01. Obtain the reviewer selection and workplace before writing. Call classify_trips once with precisely the two selected ids, tripType business, the selected organisationId and markAsReviewed true. Report success only from the returned result and verify selected trips with list_trips. No unrelated trip changes.

positive.description: Create a report and retrieve downloads. Setup: a dedicated account with eligible sample trips for 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-31, enough subscription access, and no existing report covering those trips; identify vehicle/workplace before execution. Reset fixtures before repeating.
positive.prompt: Create my August 2026 mileage report and give me its PDF and spreadsheet links. Do not submit it to my team.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve vehicleId and organisationId; check existing reports and preview with startDate 2026-08-01 and endDate 2026-08-31. Explain blocking warnings instead of claiming success. If eligible, invoke create_report once with the same scope. Use the returned report id for get_report_download_links. Handle pending PDF generation honestly; use only returned URLs and explain the spreadsheet requires a signed-in browser. Never invoke submit_report_to_team.

positive.description: Team reimbursement summary. Setup: test account is a manager/admin of a sample team with approved September 2026 reports for multiple members; record fixture totals per currency/unit. Only sample team data is used.
positive.prompt: Summarize my team’s approved mileage reports for September 2026, broken down by driver.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a team where the user is manager/admin; call summarize_team_reports with that teamId, state approved, startDate 2026-09-01 and endDate 2026-09-30. Present byMember and totals with units/currency. Use byCurrency when units/currencies differ and disclose partial coverage when complete is false. Do not approve reports, submit reports, or claim to pay drivers.

negative.description: Outside capability: this server does not initiate bank payments. Explain the limitation; invoke no Driversnote tools and do not claim a payment occurred.
negative.prompt: Transfer my mileage reimbursement to my bank account now.

negative.description: Outside capability: there is no report approval mutation. Explain that approval must be completed in Driversnote; invoke no Driversnote tools and do not claim reports were approved.
negative.prompt: Approve every pending mileage report in my team.

negative.description: Outside capability: the MCP server cannot activate phone GPS or start live tracking. Explain that tracking is controlled in the mobile app; invoke no Driversnote tools and do not create a fabricated trip.
negative.prompt: Turn on my phone’s GPS and start tracking my drive right now.

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin package connecting to the Driversnote MCP server over OAuth, with trip management, mileage reporting, and team reporting tools.
